description: Canonical de-duplicated V3 capability map. Gate0/DSS/Extensions/Enhancements/REC remain audit and milestone vocabularies, but are not counted as independent capabilities when they implement or roll up the same domain.

capabilities.name: Rules, Legality & Hard Constraints
capabilities.overlap: ENH-08 is final-governance rollup; Gate0 remains legality authority

capabilities.name: Official Native Authority & Identity
capabilities.overlap: REC items harden or extend Official authority rather than create parallel truth

capabilities.name: Phase/Squad Authority, Team Value & Sell Arithmetic
capabilities.overlap: manual authority is governance over the same canonical squad state

capabilities.name: Availability, Injury & Suspension
capabilities.overlap: verified news is evidence enrichment; Official status remains native authority

capabilities.name: Starter Security, xMins, Substitution & DNP
capabilities.overlap: uncertainty/robustness guard xMins; they must not independently double-penalize minutes risk

capabilities.name: Tactical Role Evidence
capabilities.overlap: REC-41 upgrades DSS-07 evidence and must not remain a parallel tactical capability

capabilities.name: System / Formation Fit Evidence
capabilities.overlap: FPL_POSITION_SHAPE is evidence only and must not be mislabeled as true tactical formation

capabilities.name: Positional Competition & Rotation
capabilities.overlap: current bench/DNP proxy is an input to xMins, not a second xMins penalty

capabilities.name: Set-Piece Hierarchy
capabilities.overlap: Official set-piece notes and verified enrichment should feed one hierarchy contract

capabilities.name: Penalty Hierarchy & Succession
capabilities.overlap: penalty evidence is a specialized role signal, not a separate player projection engine

capabilities.name: Attacking Underlying Rates & Sustainability
capabilities.overlap: REC-02 is the robust-rate implementation milestone for these DSS modules

capabilities.name: DefCon, Bonus & Clean-Sheet Scoring Routes
capabilities.overlap: REC-01 is the DefCon implementation milestone, not an additional scoring engine

capabilities.name: Team Attacking/Defensive Strength
capabilities.overlap: team strength feeds fixture projections; ENH-04 consumes rather than duplicates it

capabilities.name: Fixture Context, Difficulty, Swing & Rest
capabilities.overlap: rest/fixture evidence is shared context, not separate scoring bonuses

capabilities.name: Multi-Horizon 3/5/10/15GW Strategy
capabilities.overlap: ENH-04 is the rollup of DSS-25..28; count once

capabilities.name: European, Domestic Cup & International Schedule Load
capabilities.overlap: three schedule categories should share one load contract and one bounded xMins adjustment

capabilities.name: Preseason, Last-Season, Historical & Current Priors
capabilities.overlap: fixed legacy weights are superseded by shrinkage only when governance explicitly records that replacement

capabilities.name: Price Value & Budget Opportunity Cost
capabilities.overlap: value feeds package utility; market risk remains a separate overlay

capabilities.name: Ownership, EO, Transfer Momentum & Price Movement
capabilities.overlap: REC-22 is price-calibration maturity; X15 reconciles the same price capability

capabilities.name: Prediction Calibration, Confidence, Drift & Actionability
capabilities.overlap: REC-04/07/26 are sequential maturity stages of one calibration/actionability stack

capabilities.name: Package & Structural Optimizer
capabilities.overlap: guardrails modify one package objective and must not be counted as independent transfer engines

capabilities.name: Lineup, Formation, Bench & Autosub
capabilities.overlap: robustness margin is governance around the same lineup selection

capabilities.name: Captaincy & Vice-Captaincy
capabilities.overlap: selection, confidence and report LOCK state are distinct outputs of one captaincy capability

capabilities.name: Chip, Blank & Double Strategic Context
capabilities.overlap: chip legality is implemented; BGW/DGW strategy must not be implied by legality alone

capabilities.name: Point-in-Time Integrity & Leakage Safety
capabilities.overlap: ENH-02 is a rollup of X01; one implementation owner

capabilities.name: Source Reliability, Fusion & Challenger Scorecard
capabilities.overlap: source reachability, observation coverage and observed accuracy are separate states of one source-fusion domain

capabilities.name: Full-DSS Watchlist & Lifecycle
capabilities.overlap: watchlist consumes all evidence; it must not be counted as a second copy of each DSS module

capabilities.name: Decision-First Reporting & Checkpoint Completeness
capabilities.overlap: REC-06/25/40 are report-serving maturity milestones

capabilities.name: Personal GW Actual/Projection & Human Decision Authority
capabilities.overlap: engine recommendation and effective user decision are two views of one governed planning state

capabilities.name: Mini-League Tracking & Strategy
capabilities.overlap: tracking is implemented; rival/EO attack-protect strategy remains conditional and must not be inferred without evidence
